 ----Accused/Petitioner  Versus 1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  Respondent 2. Victim ----Complainant/Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Devendra Kumar Sharma For Respondent(s) :
Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Mahala, P.P. HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MAHENDAR KUMAR GOYAL
Judgment / Order 16/11/2023
The present third bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No. 342/2020 registered at Police Station Jhotwara District Jaipur (West) for the offence(s) under Section(s) 376, 376-D, 376-DA, 323,
354(A), 120-B & Section 276(2)(N)IPC and Sections 5/6, 7/8 & 16/17 of the POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has falsely been implicated in this case.

Referring to the statements of the prosecution witnesses examined so far including the statement of Shri Shanker Lal Chhaba (PW-4), the Investigating Officer, he submits that even the date of commission of offence is not disclosed.

He submits that an important prosecution witness-Ms.
[2023:RJ-JP:34735] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-8907/2023] Jaya Maheshwari has been left out by the prosecution from examination.
Learned counsel submits that the petitioner is in custody for last about two years and ten months, trial of the case is likely to take time and prays for his release on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the third bail application.
The first bail application filed by the petitioner after filing of the charge-sheet was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 19.04.2021.

Thereafter, the second bail application filed by Banwari Lal Sharma S/O Rambabu Sharma vs The State Of Rajasthan ... on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40174140/
1 him was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 24.11.2021 after appreciating the rival contentions made by the learned counsels for the respective parties including the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 CrPC.

entities.text: Banwari Lal Sharma S/O Rambabu Sharma vs The State Of Rajasthan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Now, the prayer for grant of bail has been renewed after examination of some of the prosecution witnesses.

A perusal of the statement of the prosecutrix (PW-1), a minor girl aged about 15 years at the time of incident, reveals that she has levelled specific allegation against the petitioner of subjecting her to rape on multiple occasions.
In view thereof, the petitioner does not deserve indulgence of bail.

Contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner qua the statement of the Investigating Officer (PW-4), is subject- matter of examination by the learned trial Court at the appropriate stage; however, he cannot be extended benefit of bail on that count.
Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The third bail application is dismissed accordingly.
[2023:RJ-JP:34735] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-8907/2023] However, looking to the length of custody of the petitioner, the learned trial Court is requested to expedite trial of the case.
(MAHENDAR KUMAR GOYAL),J Manish/35
